hypotheses.X1_seed102_program: A frozen seed-102 16-feature companion core reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.50 on odd-indexed held-out high-active sites.
hypotheses.X2_category_subspace_match: Seed-101 and seed-102 16-feature decoded-write subspaces match category with exact permutation p at most 0.05 and at least four of five diagonal row maxima.
hypotheses.X3_seed101_subspace_transfer: Oracle projection of seed-102 edit writes into the corresponding frozen seed-101 core subspace reaches median downstream fidelity at least 0.50.
hypotheses.X4_rotated_subspace_retention: The corresponding seed-101 subspace retains at least 80% of the seed-102 own-core oracle-subspace fidelity.
hypotheses.X5_cross_category_specificity: Corresponding seed-101 subspace projection exceeds a next-category seed-101 subspace by at least 0.20 downstream fidelity.
